summary:
Read all 142 owned Chinese units, all 214 owned temporal/hint items, and chronology for all 89 owned people. This review rejects false precision, missing death capture, wrong rebellion/raid contexts, and ancient allusions treated as life spans. Primary comparators are identified separately; Jinshu year wording is preserved, not emended to agree with Tongjian. No extraction, source, queue or publication state was changed.
Read all142 owned Chinese units s0144–s0285 for omitted chronology and checked exactly199 items and73 people against supplied context. Secure personal events in the409 campaign,405 accession and410 fall were separated from ancient allusions and family events. Findings preserve genuine407/406 Feng Fu,410/409 siege-engine and maternal-execution, and 垂/暐 ruler conflicts, alongside invented ancestral windows and unsupported reign endpoints. Explicit deaths and sui ages were checked without inferring births. This complete bounded research report is not approval or publication. No exact Gregorian month/day has been invented.
